datasets.title: Report header facts
datasets.description: The report's title, window, scope, currency, source, attribution and whether the totals were reconciled.

datasets.title: Panel data states
datasets.description: Whether each panel of the report had its data, and why and how to get it when it did not.

datasets.title: Key numbers
datasets.description: Account totals for the window, one row per key number, with the change against the prior period when one was supplied.

datasets.title: Daily performance
datasets.description: Each measure per calendar day as a ratio of that day's sums, with a rolling average; a day with no data is a gap.

datasets.title: Ads ranked by spend
datasets.description: Every ad with spend, largest first, with the cumulative share of spend and of purchase value.

datasets.title: Pareto cut and concentration
datasets.description: How many top-spend ads carry the set share of purchase value, and how concentrated spend is.

datasets.title: Verdict counts
datasets.description: How many ads got each keep-or-kill verdict and the spend at stake behind them.

datasets.title: Ad verdicts
datasets.description: Every ad with its keep-or-kill verdict, confidence, spend at stake and key rates.

datasets.title: Format scorecard
datasets.description: One row per format: ads, spend share and each rate, graded only against the account's other formats.

datasets.title: Concept by format grid
datasets.description: Ads and spend in each concept and format cell, with the numbered gaps worth testing.

datasets.title: Gaps worth testing
datasets.description: Empty or single-ad cells beside a concept or format that performs well in this account, strongest first.

datasets.title: Briefs and starters
datasets.description: Finished briefs from the briefs file, or brief starters built from the gaps and Iterate verdicts.

datasets.title: Method and caveats
datasets.description: The basis, every default used, what was read from which column, and what was missing from the inputs.

datasets.title: Ad images and reasons
datasets.description: One row per ad, largest spend first: its image as a data URL or why there is none, whether it is a video, and why it got its verdict.

datasets.title: Daily series per ad
datasets.description: Each ad's own days: spend, the payback measure, hook rate, CTR and frequency; null with the reason on a day the ad did not deliver.

datasets.title: Ads against comparable ads
datasets.description: Each ad's key rates beside the median and middle half of ads in the same format in this account, or of all ads when too few share it.

datasets.title: Rates by delivery day
datasets.description: For each series measure and day of an ad's delivery, the median and middle half across the ads with a value that day.

datasets.title: Daily spend share
datasets.description: Each day's spend split by format and by verdict, as a share of that day's spend; days with no spend are left out.

datasets.title: Spend against value over time
datasets.description: Spend and purchase value per day and summed from the first day, with the running return on spend.
